description.en: Similar to StopEventRun, but instead of panning to a position, warps the player character to a new position/rotation with a screen fade, while a speech bubble is shown.
Message ID to show in the speech bubble via CreateSpeech.
Optional 3-element target position [x, y, z] to warp to (defaults to [0, 0, 0]).
Optional Y-axis rotation to face after warping (defaults to 0).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Warp the player to a new position while showing a message
StopWarpEventRun("msg_id", [0.0, 0.0, 100.0], 90);
